verdict_rationale: 56 of 58 requirements are high; no low or blocked requirement; no depends_on on a discarded requirement and no chain whose weakest link is below 60. Two medium requirements carry acceptance criteria that cannot pass as written against the pinned runtime (FR-ENGINE-014 AC-5 on TinyHttpd 3.1.1, SEC-PROXY-005 AC-6 on the JDK), and one 2-node depends_on cycle exists. Amend those two ACs and break the cycle before implementation reaches them.

critical_blockers.summary: TinyHttpd 3.1.1 writes no Content-Length on a 304: Content-Length set through addHeader is absorbed by managed() and commit() leaves lengthHeader -1 for 304.
critical_blockers.remedy: Amend AC-5 (304 over TinyHttpd may omit Content-Length) or plan a TinyHttpd release and bump CON-BUILD-018.

critical_blockers.summary: The mandated fallback HttpsURLConnection.getDefaultHostnameVerifier() rejects every host on OpenJDK (HttpsURLConnection$DefaultHostnameVerifier returns false), so "accepts a backend whose certificate names the target host" fails on the JVM test runtime.
evidence: scratchpad probe on OpenJDK 17.0.20.1: verify(...) = false
critical_blockers.remedy: Test the fallback with an injected HostnameVerifier seam, or restrict AC-6 to an Android runtime.
